headline: Nigeria Raises Treasury Bill Rates Across Tenors Following Central Bank Policy Hold
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria raised stop rates across all tenors at its Treasury bill auction, with the 364-day rate climbing 71 basis points to 16.60% following a policy rate hold.
why: Treasury bill auction rates establish short-term domestic borrowing benchmarks and reflect sovereign liquidity demands and monetary policy transmission.

impacts.name: Nigeria 364-Day Treasury Bill Yield
impacts.why: Higher auction stop rates directly increase government short-term debt yields.
